tiles.people: Each tiles.*: a stat tile's label on the Activity page, over the chosen range. Active people: people who wrote to a socio (an AI agent; product noun).
tiles.returning: People active in this range who were active before it too.
tiles.stickiness: A share: daily active people over the people active in the last 7 days.
tiles.sessions: A session: a stretch of one chat's messages with short gaps between them.
tiles.chats: Stat tile label: chats that had at least one message from a person in the range.
tiles.length: The average number of people's messages in a session.
sessions-note: Under the tiles: how sessions are cut. {{minutes}} is the gap, in minutes, that starts a new session.
metrics.people: Each metrics.*: a choice in the chart's menu and the chart's heading.
metrics.sessions: Chart menu choice and chart heading: how many sessions (stretches of one chat).
metrics.messages: Chart menu choice and chart heading: how many messages people sent to socios.
axis.people: Each axis.*: the chart's value in its accessible description ("Bar chart of sessions by day…"); lowercase, as it sits inside a sentence. The same as metrics.*.
axis.sessions: The chart's value in its accessible description; lowercase, inside a sentence.
axis.messages: The chart's value in its accessible description; lowercase, inside a sentence.
chart: Accessible name of the menu that picks what the chart shows.
no-chart: In place of the chart when the range has no data.
empty: In place of a card's list when the range has nothing for it.
sources.title: Heading of the card of channels messages came through (web app, Telegram, schedules…).
sources.kind.human: Each sources.kind.*: a badge on a channel, who uses it. People: people write through it.
sources.kind.unknown: A channel the source registry doesn't list.
participation.title: Heading of the card about who takes part in chats (people and socios).
participation.description: "Socios" are AI agents (product noun). A socio can start a turn for another socio: that is collaboration.
participation.chats: Each participation.*: a figure's label in the card. Chats that had people's messages.
participation.several-people: Figure label in the participation card: chats with more than one person in them.
participation.several-socios: Figure label in the participation card: chats with more than one socio (AI agent) in them.
participation.collaboration: Turns one socio (an AI agent) started for another.
features.title: Heading of the card of tool calls grouped by capability (what socios can do, such as edit pages).
features.description: Under the heading when the page isn't narrowed to one person; the _person form when it is.
spaces.title: Heading of the card of Spaces (a product noun: a shared area of pages).
lists.title: Heading of the card with the tabs of people, socios and chats.
lists.description: The access log records each time an admin opens a person's chat.
lists.people: Tab, and its list's accessible name.
lists.socios: Tab, and its list's accessible name. "Socios" are AI agents (product noun).
lists.chats: Tab, and its list's accessible name.
lists.a-chat: In place of a chat's socio name when it has none.
lists.shared: Badge on a chat shared by a team (a Telegram topic).
lists.room: Badge on a chat that is a Room (product noun: a shared chat of people and socios).
lists.resumed: Badge on a chat people came back to after a break.
count.turns: Each count.*: a count in a row of numbers, joined with " · ". "Turns": answers from socios.
count.people: A count in a row's numbers (joined with " · "): how many people.
count.calls: Tool calls: actions a socio took with a tool.
count.errors: In a capability's row: how many of its tool calls failed.
count.refusals: Tool calls the person or a rule refused.
count.writes-by-people: Pages made or edited by people in a Space.
count.writes-by-socios: Pages made or edited by socios in a Space; follows count.writes-by-people, so "writes" is left out in English.
count.sessions: In a person's, socio's or chat's row: how many sessions (stretches of one chat with short gaps).
count.messages: In a person's or chat's row: how many messages people sent.
count.socios: In a person's or chat's row: how many socios (AI agents) took part.
count.tool-calls: In a person's row: how many tool calls (actions a socio took with a tool) their chats led to.
count.chats: In a socio's row: how many chats it had with people.
count.per-chat: A socio's average of people's messages per chat. {{n}} is a decimal number.
count.turns-for-socios: Turns a socio ran for another socio (collaboration).
